triple_constraint.standards_of_creation: Five-layer bar — rule + reasoning + statute_text (verified primary source, SHA256) + historical_chain + case_law + cross_refs; no stubs; ADAM+EVE dual witness; HERALD countersign.
triple_constraint.standard_of_care: Insurance is a promise — a contract where one party pays in advance for protection they hope to never need. The insurer who systematically denies claims, delays authorizations, and misleads claimants is breaking that promise at scale. The California unfair practices framework exists because market forces alone cannot discipline an insurer who is profitable precisely because it breaks the promises it sold.

critical_insurance_findings.ai_cannot_deny: INS §10123.135(j)(2): AI/algorithm/software tool SHALL NOT deny, delay, or modify health care services based on medical necessity. A licensed physician or health care professional must make all medical necessity determinations. Blue Shield AI-based denials of prior authorization = per se violation. Effective Jan 1, 2025 (SB 1120).
critical_insurance_findings.cdi_order_does_not_bar_civil_liability: INS §790.09: a CDI cease-and-desist order does NOT relieve the insurer from civil liability, criminal penalty, or license proceedings. CDI enforcement, civil bad faith (Gruenberg/Brandt), and PC §550 criminal referral are three independent cumulative tracks.
critical_insurance_findings.moradi_shalal_wall: Moradi-Shalal v. Fireman's Fund (46 Cal.3d 287, 1988) overruled Royal Globe — no private right of action under §790.03 against insurer. BUT first-party bad faith tort (Gruenberg v. Aetna, 9 Cal.3d 566, 1973) survives. Brandt v. Superior Court (37 Cal.3d 813, 1985): attorney fees incurred to recover policy benefits are compensatory damages. CIV §3294 punitive standard on top.
critical_insurance_findings.notice_of_loss_defect_waiver: INS §553: defects in notice of loss / preliminary proof which the insurer omits to specify without unnecessary delay are WAIVED. Direct counter to delay-then-deny tactics; reinforced where communications-fraud pattern disrupted claimant's submissions.
critical_insurance_findings.disability_policy_ambiguity: INS §10291.5(b)(1): Commissioner SHALL NOT approve a disability policy with ambiguous terms. If CDI approved the form, any ambiguity is construed against the insurer. Anchor for Matrix Trust 2020 disability withdrawal record.
critical_insurance_findings.prop_103_rate_hierarchy: INS §1861.02(a): four mandatory rate factors in descending importance (driving safety record, annual miles, years experience, CDI-approved risk factors). §1861.02(c): absence of prior insurance cannot alone disqualify from Good Driver Discount. Unapproved criteria = unfair discrimination.
